Steph / Ben —

Quick background: PaloPharm is a mid-market pharmaceutical data partner looking to run a 6‑month pilot across US + EU regions. They expect ~18M tokens/month at pilot peak, with a likely full rollout if pilot metrics are met. Procurement is pushing hard on price; they want a line-item discount to justify centralized budget (not a usage credit).

What I need: executive sign-off for a one-time concession greater than our standard band — they asked for 30% off Hosted API unit rates for the pilot term. I am proposing we approve a 27% concession under the conditions below.

Why strategic:
- Multi-region pilot with immediate EU region requirement (accelerates footprint).
- High likelihood of 12–18 month expansion and committed monthly minimum after pilot.
- Strong reference potential in regulated pharma vertical.

Economics (summary):
- Baseline ARR run-rate (if converted): ~$1.8M/year at list rates.
- Pilot committed spend (12 months ramp assumption): ~$480k at list; with 27% discount pilot revenue ~350k.
- Revenue ops margin after infra & credits: ~18% at 27% discount (Marcus, see attached calc).

Conditions:
1) 12‑month minimum commitment clause (post-pilot conversion) or capped pilot spend of $120k billed in advance.
2) No additional credits; discount applies only to Hosted API usage fees, not to add‑ons (support, dedicated).
3) Legal sign-off on data handling appendix for pharma regulated data (we've flagged the template).

Attachments: updated quote (PaloPharm_Quote_v3.pdf) and MAP (PaloPharm_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Asking: Steph / Mina — exec approval to offer 27% concession and authorize Legal to proceed with the accompanying T&Cs. Timebox: procurement expects a signed agreement by 08/18 to keep timeline.

Thanks —
Marissa
